params.markdown:
The Calendar dashboard includes various visualizations for tracking actions performed in Calendar by the users. It features visualizations such as a map for plotting actor locations, pie charts for API kinds and event types distribution, and a line chart tracking event trends over the period of time. These insights help administrators understand user behavior, system events, data security, and the utilization of calendar data sources within the workspace.

**[Integration Page](/app/integrations/detail/google_workspace/)**
